assets.population: Employed respondents with valid occupation, overall at-work GenAI-use, last-week GenAI-use, and survey-weight information.

taxonomy.database_release_status: unresolved: the released workbook contains the literal placeholder [INSERT EXACT O*NET DATABASE RELEASE BEFORE PUBLIC RELEASE]

assets.assignment: Respondents are linked to up to 10 O*NET Detailed Work Activities associated with their occupation and report which activities they perform.
assets.measure: Survey-weighted share of performed work-activity observations for which the respondent reports using GenAI; respondents who do not use GenAI for their job are coded 0 for task-level use; stored on a 0-1 scale.
assets.observation_unit_caveat: At Intermediate and Broad Work Activity levels, one respondent may contribute multiple work-activity observations.
assets.suppression: Adoption rate blank when the unweighted work-activity observation count is below 20 for DWA, IWA, and BWA.
assets.uncertainty_status: not established from the released workbook metadata reviewed on 2026-09-02

construct_contract.E_task: theoretical or model-based task exposure/capability measure
construct_contract.E_occ: theoretical or model-based occupation exposure/capability measure
construct_contract.A_task: realized worker-reported GenAI adoption for a performed work activity
construct_contract.H: share of work hours actively using GenAI
prohibited_collapses: reported time savings is not measured productivity

rights.public_download_evidence: The official St. Louis Fed summary states that the data are publicly available for download through the RPS, and the official RPS Data page links the occupation and task workbooks.
rights.fred_terms_scope: not treated as governing these Google-hosted RPS workbook assets
rights.production_consequence: Do not mirror workbook bytes or ingest/publish observation values in the public repository until source-owner terms or permission explicitly resolve storage, redistribution, derivative publication, attribution, and future-vintage retention.

reproducibility.reason: The official St. Louis Fed summary says the indices will be updated with future survey waves; a stable Google Sheet identifier is therefore not treated as an immutable data vintage.
required_before_ingestion: Acquire canonical workbook bytes through an authorized path and record SHA-256 hashes.
Resolve the exact O*NET database release used for the task crosswalk.
Record explicit reuse/storage/redistribution terms or source-owner permission.
Identify any uncertainty/variance information supplied with the release or paper.
Freeze the applicable survey-wave and taxonomy vintage before crosswalking exposure measures.
